entities.summary: Teodoro de Ardemans or Ardmans was a Spanish architect and painter known for his significant contributions to Spanish Baroque architecture and painting in the early 18th century, including his work on the Royal Palace of Aranjuez and the Royal Palace of La Granja de San Ildefonso.
